drhp.business: The Company is engaged in construction activity, undertaking large-scale EPC projects across roads, irrigation, water distribution, mining and industrial construction for Central and State Government agencies, NHAI, MoRTH and other institutional and private-sector clients. As per Accounting Standard AS-17, the business falls under only one segment.
drhp.expansion: With the successful completion of CIRP and fulfilment of OTS, the Company has entered a new phase focused on business revival, operational strengthening and sustainable growth, leveraging its infrastructure-sector experience to rebuild and expand business operations. The Company is actively pursuing suitable business opportunities and strengthening its project pipeline (roads, irrigation, water distribution, mining, industrial construction) but does not name a specific plant, site or capacity-addition project with a commissioning or ramp timeline in this bundle.

litigation.note: The Company was under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) for part of the year, up to 10th September 2025 (withdrawal of insolvency proceedings), and has complied with a proposal filed under Section 12A of the IBC before the Hon'ble NCLT, Hyderabad Bench, followed by fulfilment of OTS (one-time settlement) obligations — read in the Board's/Directors' Report and Corporate Governance Report.
